title: Al-Askari Shrine
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Al-Askari historic shrine core:raw mapped main outline,12m flat-roofed body,gold bulb dome on blue drum,twin gold single-balcony minarets,open marble portico and tall blue-bordered pointed golden iwan. Surrounding expansion,courtyard structures and other shrine buildings remain host content. Picture-proportioned dome differs from an unresolved68m map part tag;all vertical subdivisions and fine details are estimates. Shared materials,four browser LODs,no unique tile art or furnished interior.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact way1188251537/Q309484 is current viewer building35185560340369. Its12 raw outline vertices and12m body height,original anchor and heading remain unchanged. Current building parts locate the central dome and two front minarets. PositiveX ENE across the shrine;positiveZ SSE toward the projecting marble portico and forecourt. sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped body height12m is retained. Current minaret parts carry36m and their tips use36m above the review floor.
